routes.name: R-PF-ARBITRARY-LATTICE
routes.retired_because: An arbitrary stable lattice need not carry the rational defining tensors integrally; the exact p=2 projector obstruction excludes this shortcut, not the framed realization statement.

C9000001.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 001 (Milne’s rationality conjecture and algebraic specialization.; papers: Milne's rationality conjecture for abelian varieties; Lean status: UNFORMALIZED (No Lean proof in openai/math)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

MR-MAIN.statement: thm:main: all complementary Hodge-divisor pairings are one rational number in every stated realization, for every prime.

MR-CM-TRANSPORT.statement: cor:cm-transport: one special-fiber quasi-isogeny from a power transports the Hodge class to a CM lift in every realization.

MR-PRESCRIBED-TRANSPORT.statement: prop:transport(2): realize the repeated prescribed filtration while retaining simultaneous, rationally normalized tensor transport.

MR-AUX-DATUM.statement: lem:auxiliary-datum: the isotypic restriction-of-scalars enlargement is quasi-split and strongly admissible at every prime, with an adapted self-dual closed embedding.

MR-NORMALIZATION.statement: All local polarization multipliers equal one rational ratio of divisor intersections; the codimension-r tensor multiplier is its r-th power.

PF-REALIZATION.statement: lem:admissible-realization: an admissible flag in the prescribed geometric J-orbit is realized after finite extension by an abelian lift with one exact algebraic tensor-preserving marking, including p=2.

PF-FLAG.statement: The specified cohomological flag lies in the J-admissible period locus and has a framed point at the fixed parahoric level after finite extension.
PF-FLAG.source_locator: PR arXiv:2106.08270v6 section 3.1.1 and (3.1.9); realization_proof.md Step 2

PF-INTEGRAL.statement: The adapted integral local Shimura point is the same tensor-compatible marked Siegel RZ point with the universal abelian realization, also at p=2.
PF-INTEGRAL.source_locator: KZ arXiv:2505.02165v1 Theorem 2.1.12; PR section 4.10.1; GLX arXiv:2208.07195v3 Corollary 6.3

PF-SAME-MARKING.statement: For the fixed universal algebraic quasi-isogeny, finite-level prime-to-p tensor discrepancies vanish on every component by Hecke witnesses; its inverse remains the prescribed crystalline period marking.
PF-SAME-MARKING.source_locator: GLX arXiv:2208.07195v3 Corollary 3.13 and proof of Corollary 6.3; realization_proof.md Steps 3-5

PF-CORE.statement: Universal Frobenius basis-change and faithful-center identities, and simultaneous propagation of locally constant tensor discrepancies from a fixed good-point set meeting every connected component.

PF-WA.statement: The manuscript's finite local-field descent and weak admissibility imply admissibility by Colmez-Fontaine with N=0, including p=2.

PF-LATTICE-OBSTRUCTION.statement: At p=2, a stable lattice need not carry a rational projector integrally. This excludes the arbitrary-lattice shortcut only, not the manuscript's existential lemma.

MR-FILTRATION.statement: thm:filtration: construct the constrained balanced Lagrangian filtration with weak admissibility against every subisocrystal and finite local-field descent.

MR-WEIL.statement: prop:weil: the balanced-Weil dichotomy gives vanishing complementary pairings or a simultaneous rational Lefschetz class.

MR-WEIL-ORTHOGONALITY.statement: lem:weil-orthogonality: absence of an invertible endomorphism in U forces all complementary Lefschetz pairings to vanish.

MR-WEIL-GROUP.statement: lem:weil-group: the balanced determinant-similitude group supplies the Hodge datum, geometric flag orbit, and determinant multiplier.

MR-LIFT-HOM.statement: lem:lift-hom: lift specified rational algebraic filtration-preserving homomorphisms, with symmetry and identities.

MR-DIVISOR-SPAN.statement: lem:weil-divisor-span: a rational nondegenerate pure-block divisor on the projector summand rationally spans the determinant classes by divisor products.

MR-CM-REDUCTION.statement: lem:cm-reduction: rational Hodge classes on CM varieties are rational sums of pullbacks of balanced Weil classes with good reduction.

MR-PULLBACK.statement: lem:pairing-functorial: rational homomorphism pullback preserves the simultaneous rational Lefschetz pairing property.

MR-CM-HODGE-EXTERNAL.statement: Unverified companion CM Hodge assertion. It is not assumed proved and is not a dependency of PF-REALIZATION or MR-MAIN.

MR-ALGEBRAIC-SPECIALIZATION.statement: cor:algebraic-specialization: one rational cycle represents all specialization components; the stated deduction has a separate unverified companion-CM-Hodge dependency.

F001_MILNE_521_LIFTING_CITATION.statement: Section 5.21 of Milne's SVp.pdf (v2.2, cited in OpenAI Family 001) proves the required lifting theorem with additional Hodge structure needed for lem:admissible-realization.

F001_KISIN_SEPARATE_ISOGENY_SHORTCUT.statement: Kisin (2017) Proposition 1.4.15 alone suffices to establish lem:admissible-realization without proving that a single fixed-marking algebraic quasi-isogeny simultaneously realizes the prescribed crystalline filtration and preserves all prime-to-p structure tensors.
